_comment: Edit the owner/repo, bundle IDs, icons, and descriptions. The generator reads the LATEST release of each repo and picks one iOS IPA (any .ipa not containing 'vision'/'xros') and one visionOS IPA (name contains 'vision' or 'xros'). Ports with no GitHub release yet are simply skipped — leave them listed and they appear automatically the day they ship.

ios.name: HarbourMasters Ports — iPhone & iPad
ios.subtitle: The HarbourMasters N64 ports, natively on iOS
ios.description: Pristine iOS ports of the HarbourMasters native N64 decompilation projects — Ship of Harkinian and friends. Bring your own ROM; the apps extract it on device.

visionos.name: HarbourMasters Ports — Apple Vision Pro
visionos.subtitle: HarbourMasters N64 ports in 2D and stereoscopic 3D
visionos.description: Pristine Apple Vision Pro ports of the HarbourMasters native N64 decompilation projects, with a world-locked stereoscopic 3D mode. Bring your own ROM; the apps extract it on device.

apps.name: Ship of Harkinian
apps.subtitle: Ocarina of Time for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: The Ship of Harkinian port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, running natively on Metal — the full quest with saves, the enhancements menu, texture-pack support, and on Apple Vision Pro a stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own Ocarina of Time ROM and the app extracts it on device.

apps.name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian
apps.subtitle: Majora's Mask for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: The 2 Ship 2 Harkinian port of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask, running natively on Metal, with the enhancements menu, texture-pack support, and an Apple Vision Pro stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own Majora's Mask ROM and the app extracts it on device.

apps.subtitle: Star Fox 64 for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: The Starship port of Star Fox 64, running natively on Metal, with an Apple Vision Pro stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own Star Fox 64 ROM and the app extracts it on device.

apps.localizedDescription: The SpaghettiKart port of Mario Kart 64, running natively on Metal, with an Apple Vision Pro stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own Mario Kart 64 ROM and the app extracts it on device.

apps.localizedDescription: The Ghostship port, running natively on Metal, with an Apple Vision Pro stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own ROM and the app extracts it on device.
